programme.sub-title: EP24 How to Catch a Hedgehog
programme.desc: After an encounter with Dr. Eggman, Sonic finds himself unable to stop running. Chris and his grandfather Chuck soon discover that Eggman's E-88 is behind Sonic's problem.

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Their work done, Doctor Furcas and Lamia head back to the Demon World, but Oga, Beel, and Furuichi accidentally hitch along for the ride! With Alaindelon out of commission after exceeding his maximum interdimensional transfer weight limit, the gang has no choice but to search for his daughter, but they have to make it through Vlad's Haunt in one piece first!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: In search of Alaindelon's daughter so they can get back home, Oga and the gang head to a city of criminal Demon Beast poachers to rescue her. But before they get the chance, a giant monster appears to take revenge on the poachers for the harm they've done to Vlad's Haunt. And the only one who can stand toe-to-toe with it is... Baby Beel?!

programme.title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress [English Subtitle]
programme.sub-title: Kabaneri of the Iron Fortress E04 [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: At a time when the industrial revolution was carrying the world into the modern age, a horde of undead monsters suddenly appeared. They could not be killed unless their hearts, which were protected by a layer of iron, were pierced. Humans bitten by them would come back as undead monsters themselves. These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

These undead, which would later be known as "Kabane," exploded in population until they finally overran the world. The people of Hinomoto, a nation in the far east, built fortresses known as "stations" throughout the land that have allowed them to survive the threat of the Kabane. People can only travel between these stations using fortified steam locomotives known as "Hayajiro," and they have managed to stay alive by sharing resources in this way. Ikoma is a young steamsmith living at Aragane Station, a city that specializes in the manufacture of iron and steam engines. He is working on developing a unique anti-Kabane weapon called a "piercing gun" as he waits for his chance to prove his strength. Then, one day, a Hayajiro called the "Iron Fortress" makes its way through the front lines to arrive at Aragane Station. When Ikoma begins his usual maintenance routine, he sees a mysterious girl who is exempt from her Kabane inspection. That night, Ikoma sees the girl again and learns that her name is Mumei, but then an out-of-control Hayajiro overrun by Kabane charges into Aragane Station. The Kabane pour out of the train into Aragane Station. Ikoma races against the flow of the panicked residents, this time determined not to run away, but to defeat the Kabane with his piercing gun!

programme.title: The World Cup Economy
programme.desc: As the FIFA World Cup kicks off, the spotlight is not only on the field, but also on the massive economic opportunities unfolding beyond the stadiums. From tourism to business partnerships, the world's top sporting event is bringing people, markets and ideas closer together. But what does it take to turn global exposure into long-term growth? And what are the new trends shaping sports marketing? Join us on BizTalk as we explore the business opportunities behind "the beautiful game."

programme.title: Meet China: Turning Villages into Stages, Taking Creativity to the World
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we step into the frontlines of rural revitalization to see how a Gen-Z village chief is breathing new life into her hometown. We then visit the world’s toy capital, where Chinese manufacturing is turning culture and creativity into global stories. From a green beef cycle near Beijing to rice-prawn co-culture in Cambodia, this episode explores how technology, industry and cooperation are helping land thrive and livelihoods grow.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI talent race and the future of work
programme.desc: As artificial intelligence (AI) transforms industries worldwide, competition in AI is increasingly driven not only by technology, but also by talent, skills and workforce development. In this episode of BizTalk, CGTN's Lily Lyu speaks with industry leaders and universities, to explore how AI is reshaping talent demand across industries, and how China is building a broader AI talent pipeline for the future.

programme.title: Innovating at Scale: Behind the Scenes of AMNC26
programme.desc: Ahead of the World Economic Forum's (WEF) Annual Meeting of the New Champions, or known as the "Summer Davos" in Dalian, CGTN’s Michael Wang speaks with three key WEF organizers to explore what it takes to scale innovation in a rapidly changing world. This special discussion offers an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at how the WEF brings together innovators, businesses and policymakers to turn ideas into real-world change.

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc: From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances. The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO
programme.desc: In a Dai village called "Manluanzhan" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm? In Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Meet China: Starting Green, Reaching the Future
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, wind becomes more than a natural force—it powers a greener future across China and Europe. A piece of fabric reveals how Chinese innovation is reshaping global perceptions of manufacturing. Ancient ruins in central China are reimagined as immersive cultural experiences, turning heritage into living memory. And in Laos, Chinese agricultural expertise is helping farmers unlock higher yields and new opportunities. From energy and textiles to tourism and farming, this episode shows how innovation is renewing tradition and connecting futures across borders.

And in Laos, Chinese agricultural expertise is helping farmers unlock higher yields and new opportunities. From energy and textiles to tourism and farming, this episode shows how innovation is renewing tradition and connecting futures across borders.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI talent race and the future of work
programme.desc: As artificial intelligence (AI) transforms industries worldwide, competition in AI is increasingly driven not only by technology, but also by talent, skills and workforce development. In this episode of BizTalk, CGTN's Lily Lyu speaks with industry leaders and universities, to explore how AI is reshaping talent demand across industries, and how China is building a broader AI talent pipeline for the future.

programme.title: China's Industrial Chains: Threads of Resilience
programme.desc: What is clothing made from? Not just cotton or wool. Sometimes, it starts with a single drop of oil! Follow CGTN's Wang Tianyu and take a closer look at China's textile and garment industry, and unravel the threads that connect China's industrial past, present and future.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Herbal Way of Life
programme.desc: 'Medicine tonic is not as good as food tonic' - this Chinese saying is a core principle of Traditional Chinese Medicine. It is believed that the right diet and nourishment can cure and reverse the effects of disease, hence considered an inevitable source of natural health preservation. In this Foodwise episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May explore this ancient concept of medicine food homology as they taste their way through different herbs, chat to experts of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and visit venues that combine conventional principles with modern ideas. Dive deep into the origin of TCM with us as we learn about the harmony between man and nature and its application in modern functional foods!

programme.title: From Stone to Story
programme.desc: China's profound stone carving culture dates back to the Han Dynasty (202 BC – 220 AD) and flourished during the Tang Dynasty (618 – 907 AD), evolving into a distinctive art form and unique cultural practice. Among many places famous for stone carving, Hui’an County—through generations of dedicated artisans—has risen to prominence and earned the esteemed title of "World Capital of Stone Carving," awarded by the World Crafts Council. The county’s skilled stonemasons are celebrated for their ability to transform ordinary pieces of rock into beautiful works of art. This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui’an stone carving and reveals how it has been influenced by the area’s close proximity to the sea.

programme.title: A dough figurine artist transcending tradition
programme.desc: A video that went viral during the Beijing 2022 Winter Olympics captured a heartwarming moment – when Albert II, Prince of Monaco asked a Chinese dough figurine artist to make a second piece to take home for his twins. CGTN's Dong Xue sits down with the artist to learn more about his traditional craft.

programme.title: China Bound: Chongqing
programme.desc: Join us in southwest China's Chongqing, one of the world's biggest cities. From futuristic skylines and cyberpunk streets, to fire-breathing opera, spicy hotpot and kungfu tea, we're diving deep into this megacity the size of Austria.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.1
programme.desc: Lhasa, set high on the “Roof of the World” in China’s southwest, is both the capital of Xizang Autonomous Region, and the spiritual heart of Tibetan culture. In this episode, host Tianran He ventures deep into the fabled Potala Palace, discovering ancient meditation caves, priceless relics and golden rooftops. Then, he tries his hand at Tibetan papermaking, learning how a poisonous ingredient is crucial for making paper that can survive for centuries. Finally, Tianran dons his apron and learns to make iconic Tibetan dishes, including one said to reveal your fortune!

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.3
programme.desc: Inner Mongolia spans China from east to west. Little wonder then, that it's such a land of diversity - epic landscapes of forests, grasslands and deserts, Inner Mongolia has it all!

programme.desc: In this episode, through the new fashion of five-star cruise tour on the Three Gorges, with comfortable and convenient high-end experiences, we take the audience to travel along the river, multi-dimensionally show the most spectacular and beautiful landscape gallery along the Yangtze River, feel the unique charm of canyons, rapids and cultural relics on both banks, and convey the new charm of Yangtze River cultural tourism.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-6 Shandong Mantis Style
programme.desc: The final episode traces the cross-ocean transmission of Shandong Mantis Style. In the mountains of northern Italy, host Kleber visits Dante Basili, a veteran Italian practitioner in his sixties, who recounts travelling to China 36 years ago to learn Mantis Style and returning home to teach Chinese martial arts ever since. Kleber then heads to Shandong to meet Yu Bo and Yu Tao, sons of Mantis Style grandmaster Yu Hai. He witnesses a traditional apprenticeship ceremony and explores the style’s fighting essence: adopting its spirit rather than merely copying its form. The episode shows how Mantis Style has taken root and flourished in different cultural settings. Ultimately, this journey across Europe and Asia suggests that transmission is not only about techniques, but also about dialogue across time and distance, and a shared resonance of spirit between cultures.

programme.title: Foodwise: Eat Like Confucius
programme.desc: "Foodwise" host Tianran He explores the ancient town of Qufu, the birthplace of Confucius. Together with a 75th generation descendant of the sage himself, they explore one of Confucius' lifelong pursuits: To cultivate oneself for the betterment of others. From the sophisticated cooking techniques and dining etiquette of Confucian cuisine, which was used for banqueting emperors and aristocrats, to getting hands on with street food and local delicacies, Tianran explores how Confucius' ideals have permeated through modern day life in Qufu.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: Foodwise: Xilingol
programme.desc: The Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region is located in the northern part of China, stretching from northeast to southwest side. In Xilin Gol, the horses, sheep and cows could be found every where. The local cuisines here are so attractive to the tourists, such as the roasted lamb is a traditional local dish. And the fired stone fried lamb is so hard to find if you are not traveling to Inner Mongolia. Have you ever tried salted milk tea? Just join in this visual trip！

programme.title: Foodwise: Kunming
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in Kunming, the capital of Yunnan province in southwest China. Named the Spring City for its perennially good weather, Kunming is one of China's most ethnically diverse cities, something that's reflected in its food: From boozy sticky rice for breakfast, to the famous "Crossing the Bridge" rice noodles, and evening barbecues, there's plenty on offer here. Also, it's mushroom season, and Tianran is taking to the hills to hunt for wild fungi – but he'll need a trusty friend to steer him away from the poisonous ones!

programme.title: The sound of casting
programme.desc: For centuries, the fires of craftsmanship have never faded in Pingyao. In this UNESCO World Heritage city once famed for trade, three ancient metalworking traditions — sword casting, gold and silver crafting, and iron forging — continue to thrive. This episode steps into the workshops where artisans shape metal with fire and devotion. Each blade’s edge, each ornament’s gleam, and each curve of wrought iron tells a story of resilience and artistry — revealing how the spirit of Pingyao’s craftsmanship still glows in the heart of time.

programme.title: Harmony Keepers: Guardians of Tibetan antelopes
programme.desc: This documentary series pays tribute to the guardians of China’s rare wildlife and their habitats. Through the lens of ecological protection and preservation, the series features four iconic protected species in China: the Tibetan antelope, milu deer, black-necked cranes, and golden snub-nosed monkeys.

programme.title: China Bound: Guangzhou
programme.desc: Join us in Guangzhou, a global manufacturing hub in south China with a population as large as New York’s. From browsing hip street markets to wholesale clothes shopping, sampling world-famous Cantonese cuisine, and visiting the childhood home of kungfu legend Bruce Lee, there is plenty to do during our stay.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.2
programme.desc: Tianran He explores Lhasa’s bustling Barkhor Street, where pilgrims, locals, and visitors alike circle its ancient lanes. This multicultural district, home to sacred temples and boutique shops, becomes the backdrop as Tianran dons traditional Tibetan attire for a photoshoot. Across the city, he meets high school students dancing for Douyin — China’s version of TikTok, blending street dance with traditional Tibetan moves. Finally, Tianran travels to the birthplace of Tibetan incense, where waterwheels still power this thousand-year-old craft.

programme.title: The Great Wall Homestay
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, Tianran He's heading to the mountains on Beijing’s northern outskirts, to meet some people his age who have swapped city life for the chance to run guesthouses beside the Great Wall of China.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.4
programme.desc: Gansu, in China's northwest, is a land dominated by tremendous forces of nature: mountain ranges flanking north and south press to form the ancient Hexi Corridor, and, of course, the mighty Yellow River. Taking off in central Gansu, gliding over farmlands past and present, behold the Loess Plateau's hidden beauty as we go on a quest for an ancient city called Dunhuang...

programme.title: Harmony Keepers: Guardians of Tibetan antelopes
programme.desc: This documentary series pays tribute to the guardians of China’s rare wildlife and their habitats. Through the lens of ecological protection and preservation, the series features four iconic protected species in China: the Tibetan antelope, milu deer, black-necked cranes, and golden snub-nosed monkeys.

programme.title: Navigating the Hills of Chongqing
programme.desc: This episode explores the transportation ingenuity of Chongqing, the Fog City. Surrounded by mountains and rivers, this megacity solves topographic challenges with the Yangtze River Cableway, Asia's second-longest escalator, and a train passing through a building. From the dock culture at the confluence of two rivers to a logistics hub linking China and Europe, witness its transformation from an inland town to an economic center via the Go West policy.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: Foodwise: Xilingol
programme.desc: The Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region is located in the northern part of China, stretching from northeast to southwest side. In Xilin Gol, the horses, sheep and cows could be found every where. The local cuisines here are so attractive to the tourists, such as the roasted lamb is a traditional local dish. And the fired stone fried lamb is so hard to find if you are not traveling to Inner Mongolia. Have you ever tried salted milk tea? Just join in this visual trip！

programme.title: Foodwise: Kunming
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in Kunming, the capital of Yunnan province in southwest China. Named the Spring City for its perennially good weather, Kunming is one of China's most ethnically diverse cities, something that's reflected in its food: From boozy sticky rice for breakfast, to the famous "Crossing the Bridge" rice noodles, and evening barbecues, there's plenty on offer here. Also, it's mushroom season, and Tianran is taking to the hills to hunt for wild fungi – but he'll need a trusty friend to steer him away from the poisonous ones!

programme.title: The sound of casting
programme.desc: For centuries, the fires of craftsmanship have never faded in Pingyao. In this UNESCO World Heritage city once famed for trade, three ancient metalworking traditions — sword casting, gold and silver crafting, and iron forging — continue to thrive. This episode steps into the workshops where artisans shape metal with fire and devotion. Each blade’s edge, each ornament’s gleam, and each curve of wrought iron tells a story of resilience and artistry — revealing how the spirit of Pingyao’s craftsmanship still glows in the heart of time.

programme.title: Harmony Keepers: Guardians of Tibetan antelopes
programme.desc: This documentary series pays tribute to the guardians of China’s rare wildlife and their habitats. Through the lens of ecological protection and preservation, the series features four iconic protected species in China: the Tibetan antelope, milu deer, black-necked cranes, and golden snub-nosed monkeys.

programme.title: China Bound: Guangzhou
programme.desc: Join us in Guangzhou, a global manufacturing hub in south China with a population as large as New York’s. From browsing hip street markets to wholesale clothes shopping, sampling world-famous Cantonese cuisine, and visiting the childhood home of kungfu legend Bruce Lee, there is plenty to do during our stay.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.2
programme.desc: Tianran He explores Lhasa’s bustling Barkhor Street, where pilgrims, locals, and visitors alike circle its ancient lanes. This multicultural district, home to sacred temples and boutique shops, becomes the backdrop as Tianran dons traditional Tibetan attire for a photoshoot. Across the city, he meets high school students dancing for Douyin — China’s version of TikTok, blending street dance with traditional Tibetan moves. Finally, Tianran travels to the birthplace of Tibetan incense, where waterwheels still power this thousand-year-old craft.

programme.title: The Great Wall Homestay
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, Tianran He's heading to the mountains on Beijing’s northern outskirts, to meet some people his age who have swapped city life for the chance to run guesthouses beside the Great Wall of China.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.4
programme.desc: Gansu, in China's northwest, is a land dominated by tremendous forces of nature: mountain ranges flanking north and south press to form the ancient Hexi Corridor, and, of course, the mighty Yellow River. Taking off in central Gansu, gliding over farmlands past and present, behold the Loess Plateau's hidden beauty as we go on a quest for an ancient city called Dunhuang...

programme.desc: Join Tianran and Hannah in Shantou, Guangdong, as they explore the world of kungfu tea and its inseparable link to the local food. programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: This time Tianran and Hannah are in the scenic city of Shaoguan in northern Guangdong, where northern and southern culinary traditions converge. There, they’ll sample rare teas from the Danxia landscape, savor mountain-grown dishes, and visit the great Hakka enclosures, learning how the history of migration has shaped the way people eat and drink. After trying their hand at making ancient-style rice noodles, they end their journey at a thousand-year-old temple, where the spirit of Zen tea brings their exploration to a peaceful close.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Infra-red cameras in the dead of night reveals a forest pit-viper sense and strike a target just fractionally warmer than its surroundings. Then there's the mussurana - a snake that not only eats other snakes but is immune to their venom.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: In the tunnels of a leafcutter ant nest, we uncover a Central American coral snake sharing the burrow. Nigel meets a rattlesnake without a rattle, and a young Mexican cantil uses its white tail tip to attract prey close for a deadly strike.

programme.title: Africa: The Serengeti
programme.desc: Chronicles a spectacle that few humans have ever witnessed, the Great Migration, taking viewers on a journey with over 1.5 million animals as they travel more than 500 miles across the Serengeti plains in Tanzania and Kenya.

programme.title: Quolls: Fast and Furious
programme.desc: A marsupial native cat has stalked the mountain tops of its northern domain for thousands of years. In the lush tropical rainforests of northern Queensland, the largest surviving marsupial carnivore on mainland Australia has remained isolated and hidden from sight… until now!

programme.title: Pharm to Table
programme.desc: How far would you go, to know what's in your food? As we go about our daily lives, few of us stop to wonder what our food is really made of. Taylor Lancastor travels 2800 miles on foot, to defend our right to know, and discover the truth of what we are being fed.

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: The lions are on the hunt for giraffe. Meanwhile, researcher Rae accompanies the lions as they encounter nervy hartebeest. The game capture unit are tasked with supplying more zebra for the Ngama release site. And don’t miss the action as hungry Kwali zones in on an unsuspecting zebra. But can she hold on?

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: Phyre has to be darted to keep the balance in the pride healthy, while Pazza shows off her highly possessive nature with an unsuspecting tortoise. And Milo demonstrates why he wears the pants around here.

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: We follow the as they walk and stalk. Meat preparation gets weird for some as our volunteers make dinner time more interesting. A brave zebra stallion takes the fight to the ever confident lions. A historical moment is notched up for Wakanaka as she proves her predatory prowess.

programme.title: Anaconda - The Silent Killer
programme.desc: Few snakes are feared more and understood less than the anaconda. The film shows the journey into remote and uncharted parts of the Amazon rainforest to find the truth behind the mythical beast. Lush green forests abound with colorful toucans, noisy howler monkeys, strange tapirs, and vibrant Amazon Indian tribes. But hiding in the dense vegetation and murky swamps is also the biggest and most powerful snake in the world: the anaconda.

programme.title: Strange Creatures of the Batangas Sea
programme.desc: Hidden in the magical underwater world of one of the most biodiverse marine areas on the planet exists a community of spectacular animals more peculiar than we can imagine.

programme.title: Swimming with Legends
programme.desc: Shot over 2 years and in 9 different destinations, Swimming with Legends documents the life of a Belgium freediver Fred Buyle and his lasting fascination for the legends of the deep as described in ancient texts and mariner's nightmares.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050
programme.desc: Scientists and engineers have long realized that Mother Nature is the world's most talented designer. Join host Joe Penna as he explores how designers are using Manta Rays to change the way we explore the ocean's depths. He'll fly a mechanical bird whose design is helping factories become more efficient. And he'll even watch a robotic hummingbird that's been created to help our soldiers stay safe.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050
programme.desc: In 2050, the workplace will look far different than it does now, and one reason is robots. Join host Joe Penna as he talks to astronauts, designers and factory workers as they describe how the robotic revolution is affecting the way we work. One robot is designed to work side by side with humans, while another is puttering around the kitchen---a robotic butler that could be coming to your home soon.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050
programme.desc: There will be two BILLION more people on Earth in 2050 and keeping them fed is a challenge not only for governments, but for scientists and futurists. Soon food will be grown in high rise buildings in major cities. Host Joe Penna talks to the people who are creating the foods of the future and samples everything from test tube beef to edible insects.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050
programme.desc: The dreams of generations of science fiction writers are now a reality. Man and Machine are meeting in strange—and productive—ways. Join host Joe Penna as he discovers a search and rescue robot that doubles as a tank, cuddles a therapy robot designed to look, and act, like an actual pet, and tests a high tech fireman's mask that has a lot more than X-ray vision.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: There are areas around the world where planes, ships, and people seem to vanish without a trace. These zones have been blamed for mysterious phenomena for decades. Each place has an enigmatic and haunting story that has inspired geologists, engineers and archaeologists to study the science behind the myth.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: It is undisputable that despite their supposedly primitive technology, the societies that flourished almost 2000 years before Christ were able to accomplish unbelievable feats that forever changed the understanding of the world for all humankind.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: It was the Dark Ages… and from the cold North Sea a pagan maritime civilization exploded… and brutally raided and terrorized Europe… they were the Vikings.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: China is one of the world’s oldest civilizations and has one of the most well-­‐documented historical accounts in existence. Rich with records of early dynasties, warfare, ancient traditions and architecture, China is home to some of the most amazing archaeological sites in the world.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Lost civilizations, shipwrecks, sea creatures and sunken treasure…our oceans cover seventy-one percent of the Earth’s surface and yet, more than ninety-five percent is yet to be explored. This final frontier offers a hidden world of secrets to uncover.

programme.title: Secrets of the Universe
programme.desc: We are at the beginning of a period of unprecedented technological advancement, catalyzing a new age of scientific discovery. Travel with us on this immersive giant screen film, as we explore the most exciting machines ever conceived by man, including the Large Hadron Collider and James Webb Space Telescope. See how these new experiments allow us to look deeper into our origins, and unveil the mysteries of dark energy, dark matter and extra dimensions.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: These are the days of thirst: it is hot. Only the mountains are cool; everywhere else suffers in heat between 40 and 50°C. The rain is long forgotten. Each day is a search for shade and water. Amphibians bury themselves in mud to escape dehydration. The rest of the wild must wait for the cool of the night to move.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: As the woods prepare to sleep and mushrooms grow as the first rains fall, flocks of cranes migrate home to Spain from their summer season in the north. The stags clash their antlers in pursuit of the does; there is little time before winter sets in.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: The unknown face of Spain. Snow, rain, clouds, and cold envelop the land. The ibex migrate to the valleys, and wolves patrol the mountains as vultures circle the skies overhead. Though the landscape looks bleak and barren at a glance, there is life thriving here.

programme.title: Mummies: Secrets of the Pharaohs
programme.desc: Journey to the royal tombs of Egypt and explore the history of ancient Egyptian society as told through the mummies of the past. The film follows explorers and scientists as they piece together the archeological and genetic clues of Egyptian mummies, and provides audiences with a window into the fascinating and mysterious world of the pharaohs. To unwrap the secrets of the pharaohs is to perhaps glimpse the future of our own civilization.

programme.title: Dinosaurs Alive!
programme.desc: See the earliest creatures of the Triassic Period to the monsters of the Cretaceous in a 'life-sized' giant screen presentation. Join renowned paleontologists as they discover new fossils and uncover evidence that dinosaur descendants are still among us. Realistic and scientifically-accurate computer generated animation brings dinosaurs back to life -- in a big way!

programme.title: Wonders of the Arctic
programme.desc: Our ongoing quest to explore and come to terms with the Arctic is presented in the context of the crucial role that ice plays in the north. Ice is to the Arctic as trees are to the rainforest.

programme.title: Australia: Land Beyond Time
programme.desc: Stunning inside look at a land more like another planet than another country. Includes a rare natural event that happens only once every hundred years: the formation of a giant inland ocean out of nowhere in the middle of the harshest desert outback.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Snakes are highly-adapted to survive in the scorching deserts of Arabia, and Nigel's skills are tested to find his top ten. Will the saw-scaled viper's venom and lightning reflexes be a match for the backwards strike of the puff adder?

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Nigel explores almost every type of environment in China, climbing steep forested slopes and even wading into a sea cave to track down his top ten. But which is number one?

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Nigel explores almost every type of environment in China, climbing steep forested slopes and even wading into a sea cave to track down his top ten. But which is number one?

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Costa Rica has two venomous snakes for every hectare of land, including some of the world's most feared tropical snakes. Which of these kings of the jungle will make it to the top of Nigel's list?

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Costa Rica has two venomous snakes for every hectare of land, including some of the world's most feared tropical snakes. Which of these kings of the jungle will make it to the top of Nigel's list?

programme.title: Inhabit: A permaculture Perspective
programme.desc: Inhabit: A Permaculture Perspective explores the many environmental issues facing us today and examines solutions that are being applied using the ecological design process called "permaculture"; a design method and philosophy of life with great potential for solving issues related to agriculture, economics and governance. 'Inhabit' provides an intimate look at permaculture peoples and practices ranging from rural, suburban and urban landscapes. This beautifully made documentary presents a vast array of projects, concepts and translates the diversity of permaculture into something that can be understood by an equally diverse audience. For those familiar, it will be a call to action and a glimpse into what's possible. For those unfamiliar, it will be an introduction to a new way of being and a new way of relating to the Earth. For everyone, it will be a reminder that humans are capable of being planetary healing forces. Audience Favorite Princeton Environmental Film Festival 2015. Audience Choice Award EFFY Environmental Film Festival Yale 2015. Official Selections 2015: Food + Farm Film Fest SF, G2 Green Earth Film Festival, FICMA, Life Sciences Film Festival Prague, American Conservation Film Festival, Finger Lakes Environmental Film Festival, ITSA Back to Nature Film Festival & Crossroads Festival for Documentary Film and Discourse.

programme.title: Angkor: The Lost Empire of Cambodia
programme.desc: At the height of its power between the 9th and 15th centuries, Angkor was a resplendent city, considered the most extensive urban complex of the pre-industrial world. But by the late 16th century, the empire was in its death throes. The people of Angkor left not a single word explaining their kingdom's collapse. Come along this giant screen adventure to unveil the mysteries behind this lost jewel of Cambodia!

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: The sun heats the Earth, and life begins again. As they prepare to breed, animals wake from hibernation and build nests in treetops and caves. Whether reptiles, birds, or mammals, all the spring babies fight for survival through their first, most challenging days.

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: The lions attempt to dig a stubborn warthog out of his hole, while an influx of volunteers have arrived and Nathan instructs them with an induction talk on how to treat, walk and cope with lions. Laili notches up another triumph as she catches an African hare.

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: We get a first peek at the adorable additions in the denning enclosure. Lewa and Laili take their hunting skills to a new level and tackle a kudu, and we find out what Rae’s doing with hyena poo! Also, Kwali takes a nasty bite to the cheek. Can she hang onto her prize?

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: Penya and Paza encounter a python; the adorable cubs go on their first bush outing; Lewa and Laili keep the zebra on their toes. Meanwhile, the research team have more experiments for the Ngamo lions.

programme.title: African Nostalgia
programme.desc: Africa seen and described through the eyes of a wildlife photographer who has always been fascinated by the unique atmosphere of this extraordinary continent.

programme.title: River Jaws
programme.desc: Wells catfish! Over the last fifty years, it has colonised most of Europe's rivers - even the most polluted. This intruder has become the largest freshwater animal in Europe, and even hunts on shore.

programme.title: A Volcano Odyssey
programme.desc: Follow the story of 65 millions years of evolution around a volcanic hotspot in the Indian Ocean. Discover how a lava gush flooded an area as large as France, partially caused the demise of dinosaurs but also helped the emergence of mammals and new life forms.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050
programme.desc: By the year 2050, cops and robbers won't look anything like it did in the past. Host Joe Penna talks to designers who've created a robotic security guard. He'll work with a Harvard scientist who has developed a softball sized set of eyes and ears that allow crime fighters to see danger long before it can hurt them. And polygraphs could become a thing of the past if we can scan brain waves to see if people are telling the truth, or not.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050
programme.desc: Some of the biggest breakthroughs in the runup to 2050 are happening in medicine. Host Joe Penna examines electronic skin that keeps tabs of your vital functions and warns of trouble. He'll discover implanted devices powered by our own bodies. And he'll test out a simulator that shows him how robotic surgery will soon be saving lives.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050
programme.desc: Even before 2050 Man and Machine are meeting in ways only dreamed of by the most ambitious science fiction writers. Join host Joe Penna as meets a colorblind man who, thanks to a revolutionary piece of technology, has become a well-known visual artist who 'hears' colors. Joe also tries out a machine that uses his own brain waves to move objects, and sees a high tech skeleton that helps the handicapped walk again.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050
programme.desc: Solar powered homes are just the beginning of how we'll be living in 2050. Host Joe Penna goes on a voyage of discovery that takes him to underwater homes, and even homes built in tiny parking spots. He also talks to a group of young explorers who are planning to live in caves -- on the moon -- in their lifetimes.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Lost civilizations, shipwrecks, sea creatures and sunken treasure…our oceans cover seventy-one percent of the Earth’s surface and yet, more than ninety-five percent is yet to be explored. This final frontier offers a hidden world of secrets to uncover.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Alexander the Great…Cleopatra, Queen of Egypt…Vlad III Dracul, Prince of Romania…the legacy of these historical icons live on in our modern day culture, but the mysterious circumstances that surround their deaths and conflicting reports of their final resting places have inspired worldwide investigation and unleashed a furious hunt to uncover the truth.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Ancient architecture stands as a lasting testimony to human achievement, a visual reflection of the cultural needs and shifting beliefs of civilizations at different points in time. Archeologists avidly study the ancient architecture of the past – temples, buildings and monuments – to reveal clues about the ancient civilizations that created them and understand how past innovation has helped shape the construction of our modern-day world.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: The unexplained appearance of geometric shapes in various locations around the face of the Earth has baffled archaeologists, scientists and researchers alike. These puzzling designs form mysterious figures and alignments that suggest an important purpose, but leave behind more questions than answers, a riddle of origin that buries scholars under mountains of speculative theory and drives their search for scientific proof.

programme.title: Angkor: The Lost Empire of Cambodia

But by the late 16th century, the empire was in its death throes. The people of Angkor left not a single word explaining their kingdom's collapse. Come along this giant screen adventure to unveil the mysteries behind this lost jewel of Cambodia!

Each day is a search for shade and water. Amphibians bury themselves in mud to escape dehydration. The rest of the wild must wait for the cool of the night to move.

programme.title: Sea Lions: Life by a Whisker
programme.desc: Between a jagged cliff face and a roaring ocean, lives a colony of Australian Sea Lions. In an environment equally as harsh as it is beautiful, be immersed in a classic coming of age tale guided by one of Australia's most unique, intelligent, and playful animals. Take an intimate journey inside the colony where a life of great intimacy, tenderness, and clumsiness, must often give way to a life of great sacrifice and bravery. Dive into the world of a rare Australian Sea Lion pup - and meet the people that are trying to save her species.

programme.title: Africa: The Serengeti
programme.desc: Chronicles a spectacle that few humans have ever witnessed, the Great Migration, taking viewers on a journey with over 1.5 million animals as they travel more than 500 miles across the Serengeti plains in Tanzania and Kenya.

programme.title: To The Ends Of The Earth
programme.desc: The rise of extreme energy, the end of economic growth, the people caught in the middle. To the Ends of the Earth is a feature documentary about the state of our energy system today, and the people we meet are uniquely positioned to watch this global crossroads unfold. For example, the mayor of an Inuit village in Canada's high Arctic who is concerned that seismic testing for oil in the ocean is blowing up the eardrums of the animals that the Inuit hunt to survive. Or the environmental lawyer who goes on a journey to areas that produce energy for the Tarsands of Alberta – he learns of the inputs of energy that have to be put into this resource - and the reasons why the second largest oil project in the world is economically unsustainable. Or the river conservationist in Utah who fights to protect the Colorado River from oil shale projects that would disturb its headwaters.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Express
programme.desc: Rocky Mountain Express propels audiences on a steam train journey through the breathtaking vistas of the Canadian Rockies and relates the epic adventure of building the nation's first transcontinental railway.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: The USA is the land of the rattlesnake – there are over 30 species of rattler found here. But what's the deadliest serpent in the country?

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: With almost 2000 snakebites causing 250 deaths every year, South Africa is a hotspot for deadly snakes, with some of the most feared serpents in the world. But what's the most deadly?

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: On the trail of his top ten, Nigel meets worshippers and vipers at Penang's famous Snake Temple and meets a new squeeze, a snappy reticulated python over 4 metres long! In hilltop forests there's a red-headed krait and the David Bowie spider. He joins fishermen to net some superb sea snakes. But which of Malaysia's 40 venomous snakes will make the top spot?

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Amplify: USVI
programme.sub-title: Amplify USVI: The Global Stage: St. Croix Blowing Up
programme.desc: Host Naydyeyah Acoy-Thomas traces the rich, layered history of St. Croix’s musical roots, uncovering the deep ties to African, European, and indigenous Taíno traditions. Featuring voices like Asta Williams, Willard John, Rashidi Clenance, and Vio International, the episode explores how genres such as quelbe, calypso, and scratch band music were born from the island’s complex past. Through storytelling, performances, and cultural insight, Naydyeyah reveals how the rhythms of resilience and celebration continue to echo through generations.

Maak kennis met de ingenieurs die de machines 24/7 draaiende houden, de medewerkers die de cakes produceren en de operators die dagelijks met ultramoderne robots werken.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1
programme.desc: In de allereerste Europese fabriek van Kellogg’s, gebouwd in de jaren 1930 in Trafford Park, Manchester, ontmoeten we de mensen die maïs tot vlokken verwerken en de rijst opblazen, de proevers die alles testen, en de robots en hightechmachines die dag en nacht zorgen dat de dozen blijven rollen.

programme.title: Secrets of the Factories S1
programme.desc: De McVitie’s-fabriek in Carlisle, Cumbria, opent haar deuren en laat zien hoe miljoenen van ’s lands favoriete koekjes worden gemaakt — 24 uur per dag — in een van de grootste fabrieken van Groot-Brittannië én de oudste koekjesfabriek ter wereld.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1
programme.sub-title: Parks and Gardens: Paradise Created by Humans
programme.desc: Deze 10 parken en botanische tuinen over de hele wereld laten de schoonheid van gecultiveerde natuur zien. Deze parken vertegenwoordigen een samensmelting van de wilde, ongetemde natuur en het architectonische genie van de mens en komen het dichtst in de buurt van het paradijs dat we met onze eigen handen kunnen creëren.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1
programme.sub-title: Playful Design: Feast for the Eyes
programme.desc: Over de hele wereld vinden we gebouwen die niet door hun monumentaliteit, maar juist door hun speelsheid en creativiteit direct in het oog springen. Hun ontwerp heeft iets bijna verslavends – je wilt ze steeds opnieuw bekijken en ze blijven je boeien.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1
programme.sub-title: Theatres and Opera Houses: Unforgettable Experiences
programme.desc: Naast kunstmusea weerspiegelen theaters en operahuizen de rijkdom en het prestige van de steden waarin ze zich bevinden. Veel van deze gebouwen kun je bezichtigen zonder een kaartje voor een voorstelling te kopen, maar een show bijwonen in een van deze weelderige theaters is gegarandeerd een onvergetelijke ervaring.

programme.title: How Things Work S1
programme.sub-title: Paintball Guns, Ice Machines and Pool Tables
programme.desc: Paintballgeweer, vloerschrobber, ijsmachine, pooltafel, winkelwagen en gasboiler... Met ultrarealistische CGI-animatie laten we alledaagse voorwerpen uiteenvallen in hun onderdelen om hun geheime werking te onthullen.

programme.title: How Things Work S1
programme.sub-title: Hiking Boots, Pianos and Vending Machines
programme.desc: Autolier, wandelschoen, koffiemachine, piano, snackautomaat en abseilrem... Met ultrarealistische CGI-animatie laten we alledaagse objecten uiteen vallen in hun onderdelen om hun geheime werking te onthullen.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1
programme.desc: New pilots train in air‑to‑air combat at an international exercise, mastering dogfighting and modern fighter jet technology.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1
programme.desc: Airborne troops train as force multipliers, learning how paratroopers drop behind enemy lines to seize targets and launch ambushes.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1
programme.desc: Combat medics risk it all to save soldiers under fire. We join their training to see what it takes to save lives in the field.

programme.title: Heavy Metal Monsters S1
programme.desc: De machtige Red River is een angstaanjagende verschijning voor iedereen die langs zijn oevers woont. Er is maar één machine die voorkomt dat het stadje Selkirk, Manitoba, door verwoestende overstromingen gegrepen wordt: de Amphibex amfibische graafmachine.

programme.title: Heavy Metal Monsters S1
programme.desc: De Empire Mine op het schiereiland Michigan is de meest besneeuwde ijzermijn op het vasteland van de VS, en tevens de belangrijkste mijn van de regio. Samen met de naburige Tilden-mijn levert het een vijfde van het ijzererts voor de hele Amerikaanse staalindustrie.

programme.title: Heavy Metal Monsters S1
programme.desc: Een toegewijd team van ingenieurs is vastbesloten om electriciteit te geven aan de geïsoleerde gemeenschap van Slate Falls, Ontario. Daarvoor zijn ze afhankelijk van een ongelofelijk unieke machine. Deze bijzondere electriciteitspalenzetter is gemaakt van het chassis van een Hitachi 240 graafmachine!

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1
programme.desc: Leer meer over brandstofcellen als duurzaam alternatief voor auto's en mobiliteit in het algemeen.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1
programme.desc: Bekijk een zonne-autowedstrijd waarin teams van over de hele wereld hun eigen volledig zonne-energie voertuig bouwen en deelnemen aan een race dwars door Australië.

programme.title: Skuld: A Look into the Future S1
programme.desc: Verken de mobiliteit van de toekomst in het vracht- en goederentransport: elektrische vrachtwagens en nieuwe trends in de ontwikkeling van milieuvriendelijke vormen van zwaar transport.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S2
programme.desc: In deze aflevering eet en traint Emily Calandrelli als een astronaut om meer te weten te komen over gevaren en uitdagingen waar astronauten mee te maken krijgen.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S2
programme.desc: Volg Emily terwijl ze de winnaar ontmoet en samen de voorbereiding op de ruimte aangaat.

programme.title: Ultimate Processes S1
programme.desc: Francesca bezoekt twee bedrijven die houten huizen bouwen. Het ene bedrijf maakt de wanden voor montage en het ander is gespecialiseerd in het maken van prachtige houten frames.

programme.desc: Join Caractacus Potts and his magical, flying automobile for a trip to classic family fun!

programme.title: Get Shorty
programme.desc: A gangster turns producer after he travels to Hollywood to collect a debt from a down-and-out filmmaker.

programme.title: Be Cool
programme.desc: John Travolta is back as Chili Palmer in this sequel to "Get Shorty," now a gangster-turned-music-mogul.

programme.title: Harsh Times
programme.desc: Christian Bale, Freddy Rodriguez and Eva Longoria star in this gritty look at friendship, loyalty and ambition set on the rough streets of South-Central Los Angeles as an ex-Army Ranger (Bale) attempts to come to terms with life after the military.

programme.title: Anti-Trust
programme.desc: In this sizzling, fast-paced thriller, computer whiz Milo Hoffman (Ryan Phillippe) lands his dream job at a major computer company, only to learn that the C.E.O. (Tim Robbins) may employ some very unorthodox -- and very deadly --business practices.

programme.title: Hackers
programme.desc: Boot up for suspense and high-powered excitement with Jonny Lee Miller and Angelina Jolie when a group of hackers, the rebels of the information age, find themselves embroiled in a plot that could destroy the world's ecosystems…or their own lives.

programme.title: The Usual Suspects
programme.desc: This masterful film noir about five small-time crooks and a mysterious underworld crime boss enraptured audiences, earning a reputation as a "new classic."

programme.title: Dark Blue
programme.desc: When the LAPD's elite Special Investigations Squad (SIS) is assigned a high-profile quadruple homicide, veteran detective Eldon Perry (Kurt Russell) takes the case. Known for his tough street tactics and a fiery temper, Eldon also tutors rookie Bobby Keough (Scott Speedman) in the grim realities of police intimidation and corruption. While navigating the tumultuous neighborhoods of South Central L.A., Perry and Keough must track down the cold-blooded killers as well as face their own demons - demons that prove more ruthless than the criminals they pursue.

programme.title: The Mighty Quinn
programme.desc: When police officer Xavier Quinn (Denzel Washington) learns that his childhood friend has become the prime suspect in a murder case, he also discovers that he's the only one who feels that his friend was framed to protect the local tourism business.

programme.title: King Solomon's Mines (1985)
programme.desc: Experience wild stunts, romance and heart-pounding excitement with Richard Chamberlain as a soldier of fortune who unwittingly gets tied into a young woman's (Sharon Stone) search for her missing father. Herbert Lom and John Rhys-Davies also star.

programme.title: Allan Quatermain & The Lost City Of Gold
programme.desc: In this sequel to "King Solomon's Mines," Allan Quatermain (Richard Chamberlain) and Jesse Huston (Sharon Stone) once again travel to Africa on a journey of uncharted pathways, in search of a lost brother and a Lost City of Gold!

programme.title: The Bounty
programme.desc: Anthony Hopkins delivers a brilliant portrayal as William Bligh, the sea captain who, in 1787, steered The Bounty on a 27,000-mile voyage into danger, chaos and madness, and whose first mate (Mel Gibson) lead a legendary mutiny against him..

programme.title: Flesh + Blood
programme.desc: Betrayed by power. Bound by honor. In the battle between good and evil, only the strong survive! From visionary director Paul Verhoeven comes this epic adventure of medieval bravery and blood lust starring Rutger Hauer and Jennifer Jason Leigh.

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

programme.title: The Taking Of Pelham One Two Three (1974)

programme.title: The Taking Of Pelham One Two Three (1974)

programme.title: Lucky-No Time For Love
programme.desc: A story of Lucky, a yound girl who is taken in by a wealthy family in Russia after being orphaned in war-torn Afghanistan . While adapting to her new surroundings, she meets a man who is initially distant and unapproachable, but eventually spend more time together and form a deep bond. Despite facing cultural differences and other obstacles, their love perseveres as they strive to be together.

programme.desc: A man unravels the mysteries of his past and his upbringing while settling a village feud.
